notes.title: Update v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made you able to banish during the animation of the last card of your turn which could cause a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue with Dodge being able to dodge DoT damage during your own turn and last more than one attack.
[*] Fixed the enemy logic as to avoid getting oneshot by the last boss and also making it slightly smarter with some QoL changes.
[/list]
